aggregator.explanation: Lesson 2 wins four of six dimensions, all with very high confidence: interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and conceptual accuracy. These agents report that Lesson 2 has a functioning quiz gate, clear narration, well-timed cues, and correct Coulomb’s law instruction. Lesson 1 wins visual accuracy and polish, with strong but slightly lower combined weight, because Lesson 2 has serious cropping and layout issues that obscure parts of the two-charge diagram and labels. Overall, despite Lesson 2’s notable visual/polish problems, its strong performance on content, narration, sync, and interactivity gives it the clear overall advantage.
